baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins an exhaustive summons of human collectives to the phrase bi-imamihim before it turns to individual books.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day-event gathers all human plurality without remainder, but the summons presents that plurality through each collective's followed or advanced reference. Collective orientation is exposed first; individual record reception follows.

activation_trace.role: The branch's momentous event or severe happening makes the 'day' an occurring disclosure, not merely a calendar label.
Calling and drawing by speech supplies the summons that brings each collective into answerable presence.
Enclosure and completion make the summons exhaustive across the parts of human plurality.
Manifest human beings as a collectivity supply the social units gathered by the summons.
That which is set forward and followed, including leader, book, or path, supplies each collective's orienting reference.

changed_reading.before: The ayah announces a generic mass summons led by named leaders.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a two-scale disclosure: every human collective appears with the reference that organized its direction, then persons encounter their own records.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive giving of kitabahu into yaminhi changes to active self-reading, followed by the denial of even a fatil of wrong.
baseline_models.mechanism: A written record is delivered into the recipient's own right hand and becomes personally readable. Justice is inspectable by the subject because no right is withheld down to the smallest fiber-like amount.

activation_trace.role: Giving or bringing something to another supplies the record's concrete delivery to its recipient.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the twice-named, stable record that can be held and read.
The literal right hand and right side locate the delivered record in the recipient's own grasp.
Reading and recitation turn the recipient from a passive object of judgment into an active examiner of the record.
Withholding or confining someone from a right defines the injustice explicitly negated by the outcome.
The tiny fiber in a date stone or between fingers supplies the lower bound: not even a negligible entitlement is lost.

changed_reading.before: A favorable group receives a symbolic token and is assured of a fair verdict.
changed_reading.after: The favorable outcome is a personally held and self-read record whose exactness is testable down to the smallest claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence enacts orientation through prostration or refusal, following, participation, and trusteeship. It changes imam from a static group label into a practiced allegiance architecture whose effects can be registered at the summons.

activation_trace.role: The followed or advanced reference anchors the changed model in imamihim.
Lowering and submission supply the opening enacted test of alignment, including the refusal that marks a rival direction.
Following behind supplies the concrete relation by which a claimant becomes an organizing precedent for others.
Partnership and participation extend allegiance into wealth and offspring, making orientation a shared social arrangement.
One who sufficiently stands over an affair supplies the contrasting trustworthy representative after false authority is denied.

structural_cues: 17:61-65 moves from commanded alignment and refusal to following, shared assets, denied authority, and a sufficient trustee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enacted submission, following, partnership, and trusteeship; I infer that imam can expose the relation a group repeatedly enacted, not only a title assigned at judgment. A live alternative is that imam is an external text or record rather than a chosen representative.

changed_reading.before: Each people is brought with an externally identified leader.
changed_reading.after: Each people is brought with the allegiance structure it enacted: the reference followed, shared into, or trusted to stand over its affairs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled recompense language and its completeness in 17:63 join the focus ayah's written record, denial of withheld right, and smallest measurable fiber. The record reads as an exact settlement instrument, not merely a narrative biography.

activation_trace.role: Meeting an act with its corresponding recompense supplies the account's action-to-outcome relation.
Completion and abundance without deficiency supply the upper-side guarantee that recompense is not short.
An established writing that entails judgment or decree supplies the adjudicative force of the record.
No right is withheld, setting the account's anti-deficiency rule.
The negligible fiber supplies the finest stated granularity of that rule.

structural_cues: 17:63 repeats jaza in immediate succession and qualifies it as mawfuran; 17:71 closes its justice clause with fatilan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete recompense and a focus record with zero withheld fiber; I connect their degree language into one exact-settlement mechanism. A live alternative is that mawfuran intensifies punishment only and does not describe the record's precision.

changed_reading.before: The book reports what happened and the closing clause offers a general assurance.
changed_reading.after: The book operates as an inspectable settlement: acts meet corresponding outcomes, with neither the total nor the smallest entitlement deficient.

context_deltas.mechanism: At sea, people direct a call toward supports that disappear from effective presence, then turn away after rescue. The focus ayah reverses the direction of calling: the final caller summons every collective. That reversal makes earlier patterns of invocation evidence of orientation.

activation_trace.role: Calling and verbally turning toward another supplies the human-directed appeal under danger.
Disappearance and hidden absence remove the invoked supports from the effective field.
Turning one's side away supplies the post-rescue reversal that exposes unstable allegiance.
The same call branch now runs in the opposite direction as the authoritative summons.
The followed reference anchors prior calling patterns to the collective orientation disclosed at judgment.

structural_cues: 17:67 sequences danger, disappearance of invoked supports, rescue, and turning away; 17:68-69 repeats exposure and denies a reliable trustee or claimant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human call, failed supports, and a later divine summons; I infer that the final call audits whom people previously treated as orienting supports. A live alternative is that the sea-call is momentary crisis behavior and does not define a durable imam relation.

changed_reading.before: The final summons begins a scene disconnected from ordinary acts of calling.
changed_reading.after: The final summons reverses and exposes prior calls: collectives arrive with the orientation revealed by whom they invoked, lost, or abandoned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding honor, carrying, and apportioned provision lead into a record delivered to one's own hand and personally read. The positive judgment scene continues accountable human agency: the judged subject can inspect rather than merely endure the outcome.

activation_trace.role: Honor and esteemed worth supply the human dignity that precedes personal accountability.
Being visibly carried supplies a prior mode of supported human passage before the person bears a record.
An apportioned gift supplies the pattern of something assigned and delivered to its proper recipient.
Concrete giving carries that recipient-specific pattern into delivery of the book.
The recipient's right hand gives the honored subject direct possession of the account.
Personal reading makes the account inspectable by the accountable human.

structural_cues: 17:70's plural sequence of honoring, carrying, and provisioning directly precedes 17:71's shift to whoever receives and then reads.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bestowed dignity and then personal possession and reading; I infer that inspectability is one form of accountable dignity. A live alternative is that 17:70 is broad framing and does not specify the mechanics of judgment.

changed_reading.before: The right-hand book is only a favorable token issued by an external process.
changed_reading.after: The right-hand book is also an exercise of accountable dignity: the honored human receives, holds, and examines an assigned account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate next ayah links blindness in the present to blindness in the hereafter and intensified path-loss. This makes reading the book more than visual decoding: it is recognition conditioned by cultivated perception and orientation.

activation_trace.role: Literal reading anchors the changed model in the recipients' active encounter with their books.
A followed guide, book, or path supplies the orientation by which the record becomes recognizable.
Blindness of heart or insight supplies a perceptual incapacity that persists across present and hereafter.
Straying from guidance and intended direction turns blindness into an orientation failure.
A traversable extended path supplies the directional field in which insight or loss operates.

structural_cues: 17:72 immediately follows the self-reading clause and repeats a'ma on both sides of the present/hereafter contrast before naming the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-reading followed immediately by persistent blindness and greater path-loss; I infer that the juxtaposition makes reading a mode of self-recognition shaped by prior orientation. A live alternative is that 17:72 states a separate outcome without modifying the act of reading in 17:71.

changed_reading.before: Reading the book is neutral decoding that begins only after delivery.
changed_reading.after: Reading is an unveiled self-recognition whose possibility reflects sight and orientation already formed; present blindness persists into the encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence stages pressure to displace revealed content, fabrication of a substitute, stabilization against slight leaning, and a followed pattern that does not transform. It activates the pair imam and kitab as an orientation-and-record system resistant to replacement.

activation_trace.role: A followed person, book, or path supplies the governing precedent under which a collective is summoned.
Established writing with binding force supplies the durable record side of the orientation-and-record pair.
Writing and inscription within the revelation branch supply content capable of being preserved or displaced.
Fabricating a lie supplies the proposed substitute that would corrupt the orienting content.
Fixing and strengthening supply resistance to the nearby pressure toward slight leaning.
A running, followed way supplies the stable precedent extending beyond one person.
Transformation from one state to another is explicitly denied, supplying the precedent's resistance to replacement.

structural_cues: 17:73-74 moves from pressure against revealed content to an invented replacement and slight leaning, then to stabilization.
17:77 repeats sunnah around the messengers and closes by denying transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies replaceable revealed content, stabilization, and a non-transforming followed pattern; I infer that imam and kitab can jointly expose whether orientation held under pressure. A live alternative is that sunnah names divine historical practice only and does not identify any group's imam.

changed_reading.before: Imam is simply a leader beside whom an already finished personal book is presented.
changed_reading.after: Imam and book can form a precedent-and-record pair: the stable orientation actually followed is exposed together with the record, especially where substitution was attempted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the maternal and originary branches of the same root usually read here as a followed leader. It remains anchored in imamihim and is sharpened by the packet's descendants and sons-of-Adam sequence. Downstream prose should present it as a generative overlay on collective identity, not replace imam with 'mother' in translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Imamihim carries branches for mother, source, gatherer, and reference as well as the followed leader.

activation_trace.role: The mother as parent and nurturer supplies a generative source behind collective belonging.
Origin, gatherer, and point of return supply a matrix around which a people coheres.
Small particles and their spreading supply the image of descendants dispersed from an origin.
Sonship, descent, and attribution to a source reconnect dispersed humanity to a generative line.

changed_reading.before: A people appears only with an adopted leader or external guide.
changed_reading.after: A people may also appear with the generative source or collective matrix from which its identity was gathered and nurtured.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines material branches of four focus roots into a construction analogy. It remains valid as an anchored mechanism: kitab joins, qara'a gathers, imam can be the line or support by which construction is set, and fatil is a twisted minute fiber. Downstream prose should qualify it as a structural analogy for record assembly and exactness, not a literal architectural translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ayah itself repeats kitab and links imam, reading, non-misplacement, and fatil in one compact sequence.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing firmly to another supplies the assembled structure of the record.
Gathering and bringing parts together supplies the reader's re-collection of the assembled account.
The followed reference, including a thread or support used to establish construction, supplies the account's alignment line.
Putting a thing outside its proper time or physical place supplies the misalignment explicitly negated.
Twisting a cord or wick supplies the strand-like material whose smallest unit belongs in the assembly.

changed_reading.before: The book is a flat written document and fatil is only an idiom for a tiny quantity.
changed_reading.after: The record can also be imagined as an aligned assembly of joined acts: reading gathers it, and not even its smallest strand is misplaced or omitted.

strongest_changes: Imam shifted from a named leader to an enacted relation of allegiance and orientation.
The sea-call reversal made the final summons expose earlier patterns of invocation, failed support, and turning away.
Complete recompense plus no withheld fatil made self-reading an inspectable exact-settlement procedure.
The blindness/path and anti-substitution sequences made readable record depend on stable perception and orientation.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained distinct social, juridical, perceptual, textual, and material mechanisms without collapsing imam to one referent; the most unusual live traces were generative-source identity and the aligned assembly of a record down to its smallest fiber.
remaining_uncertainties: Imam can remain a person, text, path, record, generative source, or organizing standard; the packet activates coexistence rather than selection.
The immediate blindness verse may modify the act of reading, or it may only contrast outcomes after the focus scene.
The sea-call may reveal durable allegiance, or only a temporary crisis pattern.
The dignity sequence may govern the mechanics of personal inspection, or function only as adjacent framing.
